text:
jess: @here pager triggered from prod->canary monitoring: sudden spike in tokenization errors for model redwood/llama-13b-v2 on region-us-east-1 :pager:
inc-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0422-17. Assigned to oncall: oncall-sre
miguel: seeing ~8% invalid token errors in canary logs starting ~10m ago. samples show invalid char sequences + logits collapse.
anya: are these from the new weight bundle? we rolled weights v2.3 12m ago
ryan: yes rollout 12:05 UTC, canary 5% traffic. deploy-bot reports weightset tag mismatch on 2 hosts: host-gpu-03, host-gpu-08
sam: logs show tokenizer warnings: "UnknownToken: 0xEF 0xBF 0xBD" and mismatch in vocab-size between model and tokenizer config
jess: customer impact? any errors hitting production traffic yet?
miguel: baseline prod is fine, canary only so far. but prefix-caching causing some routed requests to canary unexpectedly. I see 200k requests routed in last 15m.
anya: that's because smart-routing fallback picked canary for region-us-east-1 due to capacity routing change at 11:58. oops.
ryan: quick mitigation: flip feature flag model-routing.use_canary for customer-tier=prod -> off. can someone flip and confirm?
sam: flipping model-routing.use_canary -> false now. command: ``feature-ctl set model-routing.use_canary false --env prod --by oncall``
inc-bot: feature flag change recorded by oncall-sre at 12:26 UTC
miguel: traffic to canary dropped to 0.5% in 2m, tokenizer errors still spiking in canary logs but no customer-facing errors observed in prod metrics
jess: good. let's kill the rollout entirely and rollback to weights v2.2 on canary hosts, then redeploy a clean tokenizer bundle.
anya: I can coordinate weight rollback. plan: 1) pause canary autoscaler 2) rollback weightset on host-gpu-03/08 -> v2.2 3) redeploy tokenizer-config v1.9 4) warm KV cache.
ryan: pause autoscaler done. command: ``k8s scale deploy/canary-autoscaler --replicas=0 -n inference-canary``
sam: rolling rollback started: host-gpu-03 -> pulling weightset v2.2
miguel: evidence suggests weight artifact was produced with an older tokenizer mapping (offset mismatch). weight checksum mismatches metadata-vocab-size in manifest.
jess: add ticket to model-onboarding for a stricter manifest validator (prevent mismatched vocab-size) — create after this incident.
anya: rollback complete on both hosts. redeploying tokenizer-config v1.9 to canary group.
inc-bot: Deploy pipeline: canary/tokenizer-config v1.9 -> success
miguel: tokenizer logs look clean now, tokenization error rate back to baseline within canary. KV cache warmup in progress.
ryan: canary health checks green for 10m. starting controlled promotion to 20% traffic with routing flag on for internal tests only.
sam: running regression evals against saved prompt set (smoke) — no mismatches so far.
jess: customer-impact summary: no customer-facing errors observed; only canary traffic affected. potential risk window 12:05-12:26 UTC for very small subset of users routed to canary via prefix-routing bug. we should notify any affected customers via status page.
anya: postmortem checklist: root cause = weight artifact produced with incompatible tokenizer metadata + routing config change routed prod traffic to canary early. contributing = missing manifest validation and routing fallback policy loosened.
ryan: handoff: oncall-sre -> oncall-night starts at 19:00 UTC. I'm creating follow-up tasks: #1 validator, #2 routing policy revert rule, #3 improved deploy-bot checks.
inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-0422-17 acknowledged -> resolved. Severity: Sev2. Timeline and logs attached to incident.
jess: thanks team. please keep communication in this thread for the postmortem draft. tagging @product and @security for visibility.
oncall-sre: leaving a runbook note: if tokenizer-vocab mismatch occurs, immediately flip feature flag model-routing.use_canary and rollback weightset to previous stable tag.
sam: created PM notify on status page draft, will post "brief degradation noticed in limited canary window; no customer impact" unless product edits.
jess: closing timeline. final note: deploy-bot needs to surface manifest/tokenizer-vocab-size mismatch as a preflight error. i'll own the follow-up.
deploy-bot: Logged follow-up tasks: TASK-7123 (manifest validator), TASK-7124 (deploy preflight token-check), TASK-7125 (routing policy harden)
jess: thanks all :thumbsup:
